Scenario fixture: a11ycore-svg-image-text-alternative-present (“SVG <image> must have a text alternative”)

Each test SVG image has a stable id of the form svgimg_case_XX. These cases focus on SVG <image> elements and text alternative mechanisms.

A. Baseline (eligible)

01 — FAIL: SVG <image> missing title/desc and ARIA name
No <title>, no <desc>, no ARIA name.
02 — PASS: SVG <image> with direct <title>
Title provides alternative.
03 — PASS: SVG <image> with aria-label
ARIA name provides alternative.

B. aria-hidden eligibility behavior

04 — NOT APPLICABLE: aria-hidden and not tabbable
Ineligible (aria-hidden, not tabbable, not IDREF-referenced).
05 — FAIL: aria-hidden but tabbable (tabindex=0), unnamed
Eligibility override: tabbable focus makes it applicable.

C. Role exclusions (presentation/none)

06 — NOT APPLICABLE: role=presentation and not focusable
Excluded by role when not focusable.
07 — FAIL: role=presentation but focusable (tabindex=0), unnamed
Focusable overrides role exclusion; still requires a text alternative.

D. Inertness

08 — NOT APPLICABLE: inert ancestor makes image ineligible
Ineligible due to inert ancestor.

E. IDREF reference exception

09 — FAIL: aria-hidden but IDREF-referenced, unnamed
This element references the image by IDREF.
Eligibility override: referenced by IDREF, so it remains applicable.

End of fixture.
